activeSlice.scope: Add an explicit existing Brand ID selector for the disposable persisted Hunter shadow anchor. The selected Brand is used only to derive its authorized workspace/account; it is never modified. The temporary Vercel anchor remains source-backed, inferred-only, canonical-readiness-gated and deleted in finally.
successCriteria: Target Brand ID is accepted only through an explicit runtime variable and must be a valid UUID.
The target must resolve to an existing persisted Brand with an active workspace membership; missing targets fail closed.
Workspace/account are derived only from the target Brand rather than guessed across multiple workspaces.
The target Brand is read-only and is never mutated by the shadow setup.
The disposable Vercel anchor is created only in the target Brand workspace, writes only audited source-backed inferred fields, and is deleted in finally.
The unchanged canonical Hunter readiness gate remains mandatory for the disposable anchor.
The evidence cohort remains at least 3 distinct real Brands and 30 paired V1/V2 runs.
Hunter V1 remains production authority; no canary or production enablement is introduced.
PES v2 CI and Security baseline pass before merge/deployment.
